cards.name: Armed Dragon LV3
cards.effectSummary: Optional Standby Phase transition: send this face-up card to the GY and Special Summon Armed Dragon LV5 from the resolving physical player's hand or Deck.

cards.name: Armed Dragon LV5
cards.effectSummary: Discard one monster from the resolving physical player's hand to target one face-up opposing monster whose current ATK is no greater than the discarded monster's original ATK; separately, during the End Phase after it destroyed a monster by battle this turn, it may send itself to the GY and summon LV7 from that player's hand or Deck.

cards.name: Armed Dragon LV7
cards.effectSummary: Discard one monster from the resolving physical player's hand to destroy all currently face-up opposing monsters whose current ATK is no greater than the discarded monster's original ATK; it does not target.

tagDuelAdapter.activeRepresentative: effect player is game.active[team], and game.cursor must match
tagDuelAdapter.lv3Standby: requires a current active StandbyFlow choice keyed by armed-dragon-lv3:<sourceUid>:<turn>
tagDuelAdapter.lv5EndPhase: requires turnEnding=true and an explicit same-turn battle-destruction record supplied by the battle resolver; current core does not persist this marker yet
tagDuelAdapter.privateZones: summon candidates and discard cost are read only from the active physical seat hand/Deck; inactive partner reserves are excluded
tagDuelAdapter.sharedField: opposing monsters are read from the other team's shared Monster Zone list
tagDuelAdapter.attackComparison: discarded monster original ATK comes from certified card metadata; opposing current ATK is computed through the active resolver and continuous modifiers
tagDuelAdapter.physicalOwnership: source and destroyed monsters retain UID-derived physicalOwnerSeat; destroyed targets route to the physical owner's team GY
tagDuelAdapter.lv5Targeting: one face-up opposing target is selected at activation and revalidated at resolution
tagDuelAdapter.lv7Targeting: no target UID is accepted; all currently eligible face-up opposing monsters are evaluated at resolution
tagDuelAdapter.summonRestriction: LV7 rejects Normal Summon/Set and Graveyard/banished Level Up sources

behavioralGroups: four-seat active representative and shared field
LV3 StandbyFlow continuation and active private Deck/hand
LV5 End Phase battle-destruction event contract
LV5 single-target original-ATK threshold using live current ATK
LV7 non-targeting resolution over the live opposing field
physical owner routing for source and destroyed monsters
private hand/deck isolation from inactive partner reserves
LV7 summon restriction and public privacy
